doc:
A constructor for topologies by specifying the closed sets,
and showing that they satisfy the appropriate conditions.
statement: {X : Type u} → (T : Set (Set X)) → ∅ ∈ T → (∀ A ⊆ T, ⋂₀ A ∈ T) → (∀ A ∈ T, ∀ B ∈ T, A ∪ B ∈ T) → TopologicalSpace X

∀ {X : Type u} {s : Set X} {p : Set X → Prop} {h₁ : p Set.univ} {h₂ : ∀ (s t : Set X), p s → p t → p (s ∩ t)}
  {h₃ : ∀ (s : Set (Set X)), (∀ t ∈ s, p t) → p (⋃₀ s)}, IsOpen s ↔ p s
∀ {X : Type u} {f g : TopologicalSpace X}, IsOpen = IsOpen → f = g
∀ {X : Type u} {t t' : TopologicalSpace X}, t = t' ↔ ∀ (s : Set X), IsOpen s ↔ IsOpen s
∀ {X : Type u} {s : Set X} {t : TopologicalSpace X}, TopologicalSpace.IsOpen s = IsOpen s
∀ {X : Type u} {ι : Sort v} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {f : ι → Set X}, (∀ (i : ι), IsOpen (f i)) → IsOpen (⋃ i, f i)

∀ {X : Type u} {α : Type u_1} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set α} {f : α → Set X},
  (∀ i ∈ s, IsOpen (f i)) → IsOpen (⋃ i ∈ s, f i)
∀ {X : Type u} {s₁ s₂ : Set X} [inst : TopologicalSpace X], IsOpen s₁ → IsOpen s₂ → IsOpen (s₁ ∪ s₂)

∀ {X : Type u} {α : Type u_1} {s : Set X} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {f : α → Set X},
  (∀ (i : α), IsOpen (f i)) → ⋃ i, f i = Set.univ → (IsOpen s ↔ ∀ (i : α), IsOpen (f i ∩ s))
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X], IsOpen ∅
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set (Set X)}, s.Finite → (∀ t ∈ s, IsOpen t) → IsOpen (⋂₀ s)

∀ {X : Type u} {α : Type u_1} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set α} {f : α → Set X},
  s.Finite → (∀ i ∈ s, IsOpen (f i)) → IsOpen (⋂ i ∈ s, f i)

∀ {X : Type u} {ι : Sort v} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [Finite ι] {s : ι → Set X},
  (∀ (i : ι), IsOpen (s i)) → IsOpen (⋂ i, s i)

∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {ι : Type u_2} {s : ι → Set X},
  (∀ (i : ι), IsOpen (s i)) → {i | s i ≠ Set.univ}.Finite → IsOpen (⋂ i, s i)

∀ {X : Type u} {α : Type u_1} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Finset α} {f : α → Set X},
  (∀ i ∈ s, IsOpen (f i)) → IsOpen (⋂ i ∈ s, f i)
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {p : Prop}, IsOpen {_x | p}

∀ {X : Type u} {p₁ p₂ : X → Prop} [inst : TopologicalSpace X],
  IsOpen {x | p₁ x} → IsOpen {x | p₂ x} → IsOpen {x | p₁ x ∧ p₂ x}
∀ {X : Type u} {s : Set X} [inst : TopologicalSpace X], IsOpen sᶜ ↔ IsClosed s
∀ {X : Type u_2} {t₁ t₂ : TopologicalSpace X}, t₁ = t₂ ↔ ∀ (s : Set X), IsClosed s ↔ IsClosed s
∀ {X : Type u_2} {t₁ t₂ : TopologicalSpace X}, (∀ (s : Set X), IsClosed s ↔ IsClosed s) → t₁ = t₂
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {p : Prop}, IsClosed {_x | p}
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X], IsClosed ∅
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X], IsClosed Set.univ
∀ {X : Type u} {s : Set X} [inst : TopologicalSpace X], IsOpen s → IsLocallyClosed s
∀ {X : Type u} {s : Set X} [inst : TopologicalSpace X], IsClosed s → IsLocallyClosed s
∀ {X : Type u} {s₁ s₂ : Set X} [inst : TopologicalSpace X], IsClosed s₁ → IsClosed s₂ → IsClosed (s₁ ∪ s₂)
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set (Set X)}, (∀ t ∈ s, IsClosed t) → IsClosed (⋂₀ s)

∀ {X : Type u} {ι : Sort v} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {f : ι → Set X},
  (∀ (i : ι), IsClosed (f i)) → IsClosed (⋂ i, f i)

∀ {X : Type u} {α : Type u_1} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set α} {f : α → Set X},
  (∀ i ∈ s, IsClosed (f i)) → IsClosed (⋂ i ∈ s, f i)
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X}, IsClosed sᶜ ↔ IsOpen s
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set X}, IsOpen s → IsClosed sᶜ
∀ {X : Type u} {s t : Set X} [inst : TopologicalSpace X], IsOpen s → IsClosed t → IsOpen (s \ t)
∀ {X : Type u} {s₁ s₂ : Set X} [inst : TopologicalSpace X], IsClosed s₁ → IsClosed s₂ → IsClosed (s₁ ∩ s₂)
∀ {X : Type u} {s t : Set X} [inst : TopologicalSpace X], IsClosed s → IsOpen t → IsClosed (s \ t)

∀ {X : Type u} {α : Type u_1} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set α} {f : α → Set X},
  s.Finite → (∀ i ∈ s, IsClosed (f i)) → IsClosed (⋃ i ∈ s, f i)
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Set (Set X)}, s.Finite → (∀ t ∈ s, IsClosed t) → IsClosed (⋃₀ s)

∀ {X : Type u} {α : Type u_1} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {s : Finset α} {f : α → Set X},
  (∀ i ∈ s, IsClosed (f i)) → IsClosed (⋃ i ∈ s, f i)

∀ {X : Type u} {ι : Sort v} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [Finite ι] {s : ι → Set X},
  (∀ (i : ι), IsClosed (s i)) → IsClosed (⋃ i, s i)

∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {ι : Type u_2} {s : ι → Set X},
  (∀ (i : ι), IsClosed (s i)) → {i | (s i).Nonempty}.Finite → IsClosed (⋃ i, s i)

∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {p q : X → Prop},
  IsOpen {x | p x} → IsClosed {x | q x} → IsClosed {x | p x → q x}
∀ {X : Type u} {p : X → Prop} [inst : TopologicalSpace X], IsClosed {a | p a} → IsOpen {a | ¬p a}

∀ {X : Type u} {p₁ p₂ : X → Prop} [inst : TopologicalSpace X],
  IsClosed {x | p₁ x} → IsClosed {x | p₂ x} → IsClosed {x | p₁ x ∧ p₂ x}

doc:
If a filter `f` is majorated by some `𝓝 x`, then it is majorated by `𝓝 (Filter.lim f)`. We
formulate this lemma with a `[Nonempty X]` argument of `lim` derived from `h` to make it useful for
types without a `[Nonempty X]` instance. Because of the built-in proof irrelevance, Lean will unify
this instance with any other instance.
statement: ∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {f : Filter X} (h : ∃ x, f ≤ nhds x), f ≤ nhds f.lim

doc:
If `g` tends to some `𝓝 x` along `f`, then it tends to `𝓝 (Filter.limUnder f g)`. We formulate
this lemma with a `[Nonempty X]` argument of `lim` derived from `h` to make it useful for types
without a `[Nonempty X]` instance. Because of the built-in proof irrelevance, Lean will unify this
instance with any other instance.
statement:
∀ {X : Type u} {α : Type u_1} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {f : Filter α} {g : α → X}
  (h : ∃ x, Filter.Tendsto g f (nhds x)), Filter.Tendsto g f (nhds (f.limUnder g))

∀ {X : Type u} {α : Type u_1} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [hX : Nonempty X] {f : Filter α} {g : α → X},
  (¬∃ x, Filter.Tendsto g f (nhds x)) → f.limUnder g = Classical.choice hX
